title: Claude in CI, on plain issues only
summary: A workflow that answers `@claude` in a comment on a plain issue of a private repository — never on a pull request, never on third-party text — with the job token as its only credential, and guards that pin the file.
postInstall: For a PRIVATE repository only: read docs/conventions/claude-ci.md before enabling it anywhere else.
Add the repository secret CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (from `claude setup-token`).
This workflow has not been exercised end to end by the kit's authors: make the first `@claude` a comment on a throwaway issue, and read the run log.
Never let a `claude/issue-*` branch, or a change to claude.yml, merge unattended (the auto-merge module enforces both).
